name: Open-Source-Face-Recognition-SDK
description: Face Recognition, Face Liveness Detection, Face Anti-Spoofing, Face Detection, Face Landmarks, Face Compare, Face Matching, Face Pose, Face Expression, Face Attributes, Face Templates Extraction, Face Landmarks
readme_summary: The Open Source Face Recognition SDK is a free, Python-based library for Windows and Linux that enables on-premise face detection, recognition, and comparison using deep learning models. It prioritizes data privacy by processing all information locally and offers real-time performance with optional GPU support.
primary_use_case: Integrating robust and privacy-preserving face recognition capabilities into applications on Windows and Linux systems.
cover_image_prompt: A digital artisan carefully examining and comparing intricate facial blueprints, represented as glowing, ethereal masks. The artisan uses a magnifying glass that projects a digital overlay, highlighting key facial features and generating unique identity codes. In the background, a secure vault door signifies the on-premise, privacy-focused nature of the process. Subtle lines of Python code flow around the scene like digital threads, connecting the blueprints to the generated codes. The overall mood is one of precision, security, and advanced technology. Rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a cool, professional color palette and soft ambient lighting.

name: video-shotcraft
description: AI video skill for Claude Code & Codex — cinematic product videos with Remotion: 152 shot recipe cards, 209 motion previews, a production-ready template
readme_summary: video-shotcraft is an AI agent skill that transforms Claude Code or Codex into a motion design studio, enabling the creation of cinematic product videos. It uses Remotion to storyboard, animate, and sound-design promotional, marketing, or demo videos with features like real page captures, 2.5D camera moves, and beat-synced cuts.
key_features: AI agent skill for Claude Code & Codex
Uses Remotion for animation and production
Includes 152 shot recipe cards and 209 motion previews
Features real page captures and 2.5D camera moves
Supports beat-synced cuts and film-grade SFX
Includes a Motion Workbench for in-browser editing
primary_use_case: To automatically generate cinematic product videos using AI, leveraging Claude Code or Codex and the Remotion framework.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, embodying the 'video-shotcraft' AI, stands at a futuristic workbench. They are effortlessly weaving together raw product images and abstract data streams (input) into a dynamic, cinematic video montage (output) that floats holographically in front of them. The montage displays sleek product shots, dynamic camera movements, and synchronized visual effects. Subtle glowing lines of code and UI elements from Remotion are integrated into the workbench's design. The scene is set in a clean, modern studio with soft, professional lighting, emphasizing creativity and technological sophistication. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant, engaging colors and a focus on clear visual storytelling.

name: text-to-cad
description: A library of agent skills for CAD, CAE and CAM
readme_summary: The text-to-cad repository provides a Python library of agent skills designed to automate the creation, inspection, and manipulation of CAD, CAE, and CAM artifacts. It enables users to generate and modify CAD models, robot descriptions (URDF, SRDF), and simulation files (SDF) using natural language or image inputs.
key_features: Agent skills for CAD, CAE, and CAM
URDF and SDF generation for robotics
primary_use_case: Automating the generation and manipulation of CAD and robot description files using natural language commands and AI agents.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan sculptor, holding a magical chisel, stands before a block of digital clay. With a gentle tap, the clay transforms into a complex 3D mechanical gear, emitting soft blue light. Around the artisan, floating holographic blueprints and simple text prompts like 'create gear' are visible. In the background, a subtle interface shows a wireframe preview and export options for STEP and STL files. The scene is set in a clean, modern workshop with soft, ambient lighting. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear, understandable forms and a vibrant, tech-inspired color palette.

name: llm-wiki
description: LLM-compiled knowledge bases for any AI agent. Parallel multi-agent research, thesis-driven investigation, source ingestion, wiki compilation, querying, and artifact generation.
readme_summary: LLM-Wiki compiles and organizes knowledge for AI agents, transforming raw ideas into structured projects. It supports parallel research, source ingestion, and artifact generation, with compatibility for various AI models and Obsidian.
key_features: Support for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode
primary_use_case: To create and manage LLM-compiled knowledge bases for AI agents, facilitating research, project development, and information retrieval.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, ancient librarian meticulously organizing glowing streams of information into distinct, illuminated books and scrolls. Each stream represents raw ideas or research data, and the librarian's actions clearly sort and categorize them into structured knowledge artifacts. Subtle digital particles and faint UI elements suggesting data flow and organization are visible in the background. The scene is set in a grand, ethereal library with soft, focused lighting, emphasizing clarity and order. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic, highlighting the transformation of chaotic data into structured knowledge.

name: altersend
description: Send files directly between devices over the internet - no cloud storage, no size limits.
readme_summary: AlterSend is an open-source application designed for direct, peer-to-peer file transfer between devices. It bypasses cloud storage entirely, ensuring end-to-end encryption, no size limits, and no account requirements for a private and instant file-sharing experience across multiple platforms.
key_features: No cloud storage, direct P2P transfer
Receive files directly in a browser
Cross-platform support (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android)
Works on local networks and across continents
primary_use_case: Direct, secure, and unlimited file transfer between personal devices without relying on cloud services.
cover_image_prompt: A conceptual illustration of two hands, one holding a laptop and the other a smartphone, with a glowing, secure digital bridge directly connecting them. Files, represented as vibrant, distinct icons (like documents, photos, videos), are shown flowing instantly and directly across this bridge. Subtle visual cues like lock icons on the bridge and digital particles emphasize end-to-end encryption and P2P transfer. The background is clean and abstract, focusing attention on the direct connection. The AlterSend logo is subtly integrated into the digital bridge. The style is a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a bright, trustworthy color palette.

name: free-coding-models
description: Find, benchmark and install in CLI 170+ FREE coding LLM models across 15+ providers in real time
readme_summary: free-coding-models is a command-line interface tool that helps developers find, benchmark, and install free coding Large Language Models (LLMs) from various providers. It provides real-time latency, stability scores, and usage data to help users select the best model for their needs and integrate it directly into their coding tools.
key_features: Find and benchmark 170+ free coding LLM models
Direct installation into coding tools (OpenCode, Aider, Continue, etc.)
Live quota tracking from response headers
primary_use_case: To enable developers to quickly discover, evaluate, and deploy the most performant and stable free coding LLMs for their development workflow.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling, futuristic marketplace where developers are like shoppers, examining various glowing orbs representing different AI coding models. Each orb displays real-time metrics like speed (a speedometer), stability (a heart monitor line), and a verdict (a checkmark or cross). A central vendor, personified by the 'free-coding-models' logo, is actively handing a chosen, stable orb to a developer who is eagerly holding a coding tool. The background shows a clean, organized cityscape with subtle digital streams connecting the models to the developers. The overall mood is efficient and empowering, with a vibrant, tech-focused color palette and a 3D isometric illustration style.
